cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cílem předmětu je seznámit studenty s principy implementace procesního přístupu do podnikové praxe s důrazem na podniky obchodního charakteru. Předmět vychází ze skutečnosti, že procesní přístup je v současné době základem certifikace jakéhokoliv systému managementu (kvality, bezpečnosti a ochrany zdraví při práci, environmentálního apod.), takže je v praxi zcela neopominutelný. Studenti budou připraveni provést procesní analýzu jako základní zdroj informací pro optimalizaci procesů.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Aim of the course is to get the students acquainted with the principles of implementation of the process approach into business practice with a specific focus on the trade businesses. The course comes from the fact, that the process approach currently represents a basis of certification of any management system (quality, safety and protection of health at work, environmental management etc.), and as such it is indispensable. Students will be ready to perform process analysis as the basic source of information for process optimization.

en.content: 1.Project management (allowance 0/12) a.Project management vs. managing by projectsb.Project process and life cyclec.Tools applicable in particular stages of project management2.Process approach to management (allowance 0/12) a.Process approach context in theories of managementb.Process mapping techniques, SIPOC3.Operations in the process approach (allowance 0/4) a.Operations strategyb.Product designc.Operation system designd.Planning and managing operations4.Product design (allowance 0/12) a.Stages of product designb.Differences in different types of systems (production vs. services)c.Practical aspects of design/development process5.Operation system design (allowance 0/2) a.Deciding on locationb.Facility layout6.Operations planning and management (allowance 0/6) a.Principles of theory of constraintsb.Capacity planning, inventory management7.Quality management (allowance 0/4) a.TQM, ISO, EFQMb.Quality in trade and services
